Package GUI

Class ReportsController

java.lang.Object
GUI.ReportsController
public class ReportsController extends Object
Controller class for the Reports.fxml view.

This class is responsible for fetching, generating, rendering, and exporting analytic reporting structures within the GoNature application. It handles four primary report variants: Visits, Park Usage, Cancellations, and Visitor Count summaries. The view dynamically adjusts layout elements (such as multi-series BarCharts, PieCharts, and TableViews) based on the specific authorization role of the logged-in supervisor (Park Manager vs. Department Manager).

Version:
1.0
Author:
GoNature Development Team

  • Method Details

    • initData

      public void initData(String role, int parkId)
      Bootstraps foundational profile properties and privileges defining how data arrays are filtered.

      Hides specific reporting features unavailable to standalone Park Managers or enables cross-park search filtering elements specifically for regional Department Managers.

      Parameters:
      role - The security role authorization string of the authenticated user.
      parkId - Unique identification number of the park managed by the user (-1 if regional).

    • setParks

      public void setParks(ArrayList<ArrayList<String>> parks)
      Populates the departmental combo box filter option tree with active national park models retrieved from the server. Called asynchronously from network connection incoming packet listeners.
      Parameters:
      parks - Nested string array matrix containing database park records.

    • getSelectedParkId

      private int getSelectedParkId()
      Resolves the target destination identification query scope constraint.
      Returns:
      Target internal numeric park database identifier key (-1 represents a global cross-park search request).

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes structural combo box selections automatically upon establishing the FXML window node stage. Sets historical choices targeting a 3-year trailing window and targets the previous trailing calendar month default.

      private void buildVisitsReport(ArrayList<ArrayList<String>> data)
      Compiles data records to construct a multi-series BarChart tracking visitor volume entry trends by calendar day. Segments bars within individual categories by visitor group classification models.
      Parameters:
      data - Multi-dimensional tracking payload mapping the raw operational visit records.

      private void buildUsageReport(ArrayList<ArrayList<String>> data)

    • buildCancellationsReport

      private void buildCancellationsReport(ArrayList<ArrayList<String>> data)
      Builds a comprehensive PieChart mapping proportional cancellation distributions (e.g., proactive cancellation vs. automated no-show). Calculates mathematical statistics including mean average daily incident rates.
      Parameters:
      data - Multi-dimensional dataset tracking unfulfilled booking profiles.

    • buildVisitorCountReport

      private void buildVisitorCountReport(ArrayList<ArrayList<String>> data)
      Builds an illustrative visual distribution PieChart displaying cumulative headcount volumes divided by visitor type. Segments tracking counts between Group Guides, Subscribers, and Individual public travelers.
      Parameters:
      data - Multi-dimensional dataset profiling visitor classification fields.

    • styleBarChart

      private void styleBarChart(BarChart<String,Number> chart)
      Styles BarChart nodes with custom colors and dark theme styles using a dynamic raw CSS injection pipeline. Modifies graph canvas grids, labels, text spacing fill properties, and operational legends on the JavaFX application thread.
      Parameters:
      chart - The BarChart node targeting visual transformation properties.

    • buildTable

      private void buildTable(ArrayList<ArrayList<String>> data, String[] headers, int[] colIndexes)
      Constructs table columns dynamically to display underlying report rows. Automatically formats raw database floats (truncating unnecessary double precision strings ending in .0).
      Parameters:
      data - Multi-dimensional database matrix records collection.
      headers - Array sequence listing localized programmatic grid view column header names.
      colIndexes - Integer mapping indices specifying how values map to internal row index lookups.
